name: parity
means: the parity of a file or a rank number: a square is dark when its file and rank have the same parity (the spec's way to say a square's colour)

why.rust: the crate reads a square's colour from shakmaty's DARK_SQUARES / LIGHT_SQUARES bitboards, no parity value
why.python: python-chess reads the colour from BB_DARK_SQUARES: no parity value
